Sagres' breaks are why most visitors are here — and why shoulders, necks and lower backs take a beating. Paddling out, popping up, hours in the water: it adds up.

The sports massage and the ayurvedic & sports combination are built for exactly that — deep-tissue work where surfing loads the body, with warm oils to help you get back in the water sooner. Book before your next session to loosen up, or straight after to recover.
Any 60-minute treatments, valid for three months, whenever you need them. Best deal for regular clients.
